methodology: Data compiled from public REIT 10-K filings, Q4 2025 earnings releases, and SEC EDGAR. OpEx/SF calculated where total property operating expenses and total rentable SF were both available. Recovery ratios included only when explicitly disclosed. Industry benchmarks from BOMA EER and general CRE sources.

sources.name: StockAnalysis.com income statements
sources.note: Used for cross-referencing revenue and property expense figures

sources.name: Q4 2025 earnings press releases (various REIT IR sites)
sources.note: Used for occupancy, GLA, and operational metrics

sources.name: BOMA Experience Exchange Report (2025 edition)
sources.note: Paywalled; summary data only. Office OpEx benchmarks by city.

sources.name: IREM Income/Expense IQ (discontinued Dec 2025)
sources.note: Platform shut down Dec 31, 2025. Historical data no longer accessible.

sources.name: Industry averages from CRE publications (Aquila, BullpenRE, OfficeSpace.com)
sources.note: Used for general OpEx/SF benchmarks where REIT-specific data was unavailable

BXP.name: BXP (formerly Boston Properties)
BXP.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $1,387M property expenses / 52.6M SF. Includes operating costs + real estate taxes.
BXP.capexNote: Not separately itemized in earnings release
BXP.notes: CBD portfolio of premier workplaces was 89.8% occupied. Q4 rental expenses were $339.7M (5.1% YoY increase).

VNO.name: Vornado Realty Trust
VNO.occupancyNote: NYC office 88.8%; THE MART Chicago 81.5%; SF 49.0%
VNO.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $920M property expenses / 22.5M SF. Premium NYC assets drive higher OpEx.
VNO.notes: NOI at share reached $1.1B. Cash same-store NOI declined 5.5% YoY. Leased 4.6M SF of office space in 2025.

KRC.name: Kilroy Realty Corporation
KRC.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $256M / 16.3M SF. West Coast life science/office portfolio.
KRC.notes: 121 stabilized buildings + 3 residential properties (1,001 units, 94.1% occupied). Revenue declined 2% YoY.

HIW.name: Highwoods Properties
HIW.occupancyNote: Low end of 86-87% year-end guidance. Projects 200bps gain for 2026.
HIW.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $261M / 27.3M SF. Sunbelt BBD (best business district) focused.
HIW.capexNote: CapEx/Revenue ratio of 26.3% per analyst reports
HIW.notes: Second-generation leasing of 1.6M SF (highest in 10 years). Record rent spreads of 18%. Development pipeline 78% pre-leased.

SPG.name: Simon Property Group
SPG.opexPerSFNote: Total GLA not disclosed in earnings release. Property OpEx of $581M covers malls, outlets, and mills.
SPG.occupancyCostNote: Occupancy cost as % of retailer sales -- key retail metric
SPG.notes: Record Real Estate FFO of $4.8B. Net income of $4.6B ($14.17/share). Domestic NOI grew 4.4% YoY.

KIM.name: Kimco Realty
KIM.propertyOperatingExpensesNote: Total expenses of $1,432M includes rent, taxes, operating/maintenance, G&A, impairment, D&A. Direct property OpEx is a subset.
KIM.occupancyNote: All-time high. Small shop occupancy 92.7% (also record).
KIM.opexPerSFNote: Cannot isolate property-only OpEx from total expense figure. Estimated ~$8-10/SF based on retail open-air benchmarks.
KIM.notes: FFO/share up 6.7% YoY. Same-property NOI grew 3.0%. Leased-to-economic occupancy spread of 390bps = $73M ABR.

REG.name: Regency Centers
REG.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $265M / 58M SF. Grocery-anchored centers have lower OpEx intensity.
REG.recoveryRatioNote: Not explicitly quantified but earnings call noted 'favorable expense recoveries' and higher recovery rates from elevated occupancy
REG.notes: Same-property NOI rose 5.3%. FFO grew 7.9% to $4.64/share. Base rent growth of 4.5% was largest NOI contributor.

FRT.name: Federal Realty Investment Trust
FRT.totalOperatingExpensesNote: Includes D&A, G&A, and property-level expenses
FRT.occupancyNote: Comparable portfolio; leased rate 96.6%. Small shop leased 93.8%.
FRT.opexPerSFNote: Cannot isolate property-only OpEx. Estimated ~$14-18/SF based on mixed-use retail peers.
FRT.notes: FFO of $7.22/share, up 6.6% YoY. Record leasing of 2.5M SF. Cash rent spreads 15%, straight-line 27% (strongest in a decade). Comparable POI growth 3.8%.

BRX.name: Brixmor Property Group
BRX.notes: Record operating results. Leasing spreads 21.7% on comparable space. $417M acquisitions, $297M dispositions. Reinvestment projects at 10% incremental NOI yield.

PLD.name: Prologis
PLD.totalRentableSFNote: ~1.15B SF occupied in operating portfolio. Total managed ~1.3B SF globally.
PLD.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $1,964M rental expenses / 1,150M occupied SF. Industrial NNN leases shift most OpEx to tenants.
PLD.recoveryRatioNote: Industrial NNN leases typically recover 95%+ of operating expenses
PLD.notes: Record 228M SF of leases signed in 2025. Core FFO $5.81/share. Rental expenses include property taxes, insurance, maintenance passed through or absorbed.

REXR.name: Rexford Industrial Realty
REXR.totalRentableSFNote: 424 properties, ~50.3M rentable SF (increased from 419 properties mid-year)
REXR.occupancyNote: Same Property ending occupancy 96.5%. Total portfolio incl. value-add: 90.2% occupied, 90.9% leased.
REXR.opexPerSFNote: Calculated: $228M / 50.3M SF. SoCal infill industrial, higher value per SF.
REXR.capexNote: $798M invested in 21 stabilized repositioning/development projects (not traditional maintenance CapEx)
REXR.notes: SoCal-focused infill industrial. Leasing commissions + TI surged 56% to $44M. Total portfolio NOI $752.7M.

opexRangePerSF.note: Wide range: Sunbelt office ($9-15) vs. NYC/SF CBD ($30-42)

office.typicalOperatingRatioNote: Operating expenses as % of gross rental income

bomaEERTopCities2025.note: BOMA EER figures (most recent publicly available summary). Full report is paywalled.

office.energyShareNote: Energy typically accounts for one-third of total operating costs for office buildings
office.averageOccupancy2025Note: Average of BXP (86.7%), VNO (88.8%), KRC (81.6%), HIW (86.0%)
office.typicalRecoveryRatioNote: Full-service gross leases recover less; modified gross and NNN recover more

retail.medianOpexPerSFNote: Varies widely by format: open-air ($4-6/SF), grocery-anchored ($4-5/SF), enclosed malls ($12-18/SF), mixed-use ($14-20/SF)
retail.typicalOperatingRatioNote: NNN leases in retail push ratio lower. Gross leases are higher.
retail.typicalRecoveryRatioNote: Brixmor reported 92.7% (record). NNN retail typically 90-95%. Gross leases lower.
retail.camReconciliationNote: Retail REITs perform annual CAM reconciliations; elevated occupancy in 2025 drove higher recovery rates across the sector

industrial.medianOpexPerSFSource: CRE industry average (Aquila Commercial, general benchmarks)
industrial.typicalOperatingRatioNote: Industrial properties have lowest OpEx ratios due to NNN lease dominance
industrial.typicalRecoveryRatioNote: Nearly all industrial leases are absolute NNN; tenants pay virtually all operating expenses

marketContext.inflationImpact: U.S. CPI rose ~3.3% in 2024-2025, driving operating expenses higher -- especially utilities, insurance, and building services. Average OERs increased across most CRE sectors.
marketContext.iremShutdown: IREM Income/Expense IQ platform permanently shut down Dec 31, 2025. Historical benchmark data no longer accessible.
marketContext.officeHeadwinds: Office sector faces continued remote work headwinds. Average occupancy across 4 office REITs sampled is 85.8%, significantly below pre-pandemic levels of ~92-94%.
marketContext.retailStrength: Retail occupancy at multi-year highs (95.8% average). Strong leasing spreads (15-22% cash basis) indicate landlord pricing power.
marketContext.industrialNormalization: Industrial occupancy remains healthy at 96.2% but growth moderating from pandemic-era highs. Prologis net effective rent change of 43.8% reflects mark-to-market on below-market leases.

capveriRelevance.camReconciliationOpportunity: With retail recovery ratios of 88-95% and industrial at 95-100%, the 5-12% gap in retail represents billions in potential under-recovery across the industry. CapVeri's CAM reconciliation automation targets this gap.
capveriRelevance.keyInsight: Brixmor's record 92.7% recovery ratio demonstrates that disciplined reconciliation processes yield measurable results. Most PMCs operate well below this benchmark.
capveriRelevance.targetMetric: Every 1% improvement in recovery ratio on a 10M SF portfolio at $6/SF OpEx = $600K in recovered revenue annually.
